purpose: Decision 62 measurement bootstrap, not full K-23/K-26 qualification

asyncio.derivation: Reserve 80% of each frame for downstream work at the tail; never consume half a frame in scheduling alone. 10ms gives <2ms p99.9 / <5ms max; 20ms gives <4ms / <10ms.

synchronous_native_call.derivation: One uninterrupted dispatch may consume 10% of the frame: 1ms at 10ms, 2ms at 20ms. These boundary calls exclude async Driver steps.

audio_forwarder_step.derivation: Target half the dispatch ceiling at p99.9, leaving 2x margin to the maximum; 10ms gives 0.5ms / 1ms, 20ms gives 1ms / 2ms. Includes clock overhead, excludes input allocation and effect execution.

pcm_binding.measurement: Count and size frames actually consumed by STT and VAD. Each crosses AudioFrame::into_pyobject, whose PyBytes::new copies once; fake providers never construct their own RTC frames.
pcm_binding.limitation: Excludes TTS, other Rust allocations/copies and RTC native internals. Zero visible memoryview.tobytes calls does not mean zero copies.

tokio_workers.measurement: Separate external native stack sampling, typed per-thread inclusive counts and original raw call tree
tokio_workers.limitation: Parked workers are normal; aggregate call trees have no consecutive-sample order. Sampling cannot derive heartbeat lateness, exact poll duration or per-step CPU.

workload.transport: real TCP loopback, WebSocket upgrade and masked binary frames

accounting.unit: logical payload reservations, including parser head/read bounds, queued messages and outgoing serialization
accounting.reservation_lifetime: HTTP head/read reservation is released after upgrade; parser reservation, handler admission, queued messages and pending writes stay owned through cancellation and cleanup.
accounting.excluded: application-owned request/response values, TLS/kernel buffers, codec allocation overhead, Python conversion copies and allocator retention

worker_endpoint.derivation: 64 upgraded peers each reserve a4MiB parser plus64KiB read, eight16KiB queued inputs and a minimum64KiB output:272MiB.512MiB leaves1.88x capacity for this workload. During upgrade an additional1MiB head plus64KiB read is reserved, then released after transferring the request scope.8MiB inbox/outbox quotas each admit two maximum-size messages; the worker ceiling may refuse full queues before their local limits. Graceful close uses the existing2s IPC flush budget; stop/reset admission has a separate frame-cadence contract.

overload.inbox: WebSocket close 1009, before copying into the inbox
overload.outgoing: explicit send error before encoding or waiting for serialization
overload.cleanup: permits remain owned until retained payloads and pending writes settle; close/reset does not wait for data capacity

evidence_limits: This row qualifies endpoint payload admission only; IPC, process pool, native-worker and telemetry ceilings remain owned by their separate interfaces.
The real-TCP profile measures delivered bytes and loop-lag, plus zero settled logical reservations. It does not establish RSS or allocator high-water bounds.
The supported workload fits under the ceiling; simultaneous maximum-size payloads may be explicitly refused.
Shared macOS host timings do not qualify Linux CPU quotas or Windows.

measurement.result: Delivery and reservation release passed. Frame-cadence gates remain unqualified on the shared macOS host.

worker_native_io.service: process-wide blocking I/O pool (lk_agents_net::blocking_io), four plain threads
worker_native_io.derivation: The blocking I/O pool has its own 4 threads, independent of the media pool and its payload classes, so payload saturation never blocks health sampling. CPU sampling runs at 500ms cadence; memory sampling at 5s cadence. Exact fleet throughput and CPU-quota calibration remain unmeasured.

overload.cpu_sample: retain cached load and retry at the next sample cadence
overload.process_memory_sample: typed Sample::Failed and retry at the next cadence
overload.server_setup: owned startup future retries at the existing100ms pool-refill cadence, bounded by initialize_process_timeout; close cancels the wait before native work is retained

worker_native_io.ownership: The admitted native receipt keeps its class and total permits until actual completion, including cancelled callers and setup/sampling cleanup. Worker/server/supervisor drivers receive the service explicitly; production shares the process service and test fixtures own a service on their runtime.
checks: worker_sampler_off_loop saturates BlockingIo while registration/drain/close stay serviceable
cancelled_caller_does_not_release_a_running_worker covers the reused native admission mechanism
native_payload_saturation_reserves_health_sampling_capacity exhausts payload admission while a health sample still enters the same shared pool
evidence_limits: This change integrates the existing ceiling; it does not qualify native I/O throughput across Linux CPU quotas or Windows.
Worker control/outbox, IPC and process-pool byte ceilings still need their own aggregate calibration; endpoint payload admission and native running-work admission do not establish those bounds.

commands.python: PYTHONPATH=livekit-agents-next:. uv run --no-sync python scripts/bench/media.py --output media-python.json

measurement.native: Real JPEG/PNG, Ogg/Opus encode/decode and recording filesystem adapters on a current-thread Tokio loop; each future poll records wall and thread CPU, with total process CPU and an independent absolute-deadline heartbeat. Samples are printed as MEDIA_MEASUREMENT JSON.
measurement.python: First decoder and recorder construction after import, ten-second WAV resampling, real RTC frame conversion and four parallel JPEG/PNG encodes. Callback wall/thread CPU, independent heartbeat and Python-thread progress are recorded. Captures identify the loaded extension by path and SHA-256.
measurement.qualification: Host-dependent timing is recorded. --check enables the Python cadence gates; short workloads without 1000 active heartbeats remain unqualified. Rust assertions check media duration, successful encoding and admission refusal only.
measurement.raw_captures: Save captures outside the repository; include matching source revision, build features and host profile when comparing.

evidence_limits: MacOS shared machine with concurrent builds; no production CPU quota or deployment-capacity claim.
FakeRoom input is always 20ms; 10ms in full sessions is control/clock cadence. Direct Rust steps exercise genuine 10ms and 20ms frames.
Profiled and externally sampled passes perturb timing and must remain separate from the primary clean pass.
No real Silero/EOT model inference, codec drain, recording, stalled transport, 30-minute soak or multi-process job qualification.
Direct AudioForwarder CPU is not the async session decision Driver CPU. Missing exact measurements remain null.
Loop progress under fake native work cannot establish GIL release across unexecuted native waits.
Played bytes are FakeRoom local playback evidence, not remote receiver rendering.
Retained resources, queue bytes, allocation counts and worker-wide admission ceilings are not measured here; K-26 remains open.
